photos.llama_desc: A young woman in a green strapless evening gown. She is standing with her right hand on the left shoulder of a young man in a black tuxedo, both smiling at the camera. The woman's long blonde hair is loose and her dress has a green sash around her waist.
photos.oracle_desc: A young couple in prom attire pose outdoors among green trees. The young woman wears a green strapless gown with wavy blonde hair; the young man wears a black tuxedo with a green bow tie and white boutonniere, both smiling at the camera.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a red dress. She is sitting on a couch, holding a small dog. The dog is wearing a blue collar around its neck.
photos.oracle_desc: A 2x3 photo mosaic of a Yorkshire Terrier photographed in various indoor settings, showing the dog from multiple angles including close-up face shots, wearing a bandana, and being held by a person.

photos.llama_desc:
A woman in a white graduation gown... 
She is wearing a white mortarboard and a long white gown with a gold medal around her neck and multiple colorful cords and ribbons. She is smiling and holding a diploma.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman in a white graduation cap and gown smiles outdoors, wearing multiple colored honor cords and a medal around her neck, with a building featuring a copper-green roof visible in the background.

photos.oracle_desc: A split biscuit sandwich on a white plate on a wooden table, filled with egg and sausage gravy, with a white ceramic coffee mug in the background.

photos.oracle_desc: Four young people — three girls and a young man — sit on a green couch opening Christmas gifts, smiling at the camera. Gift bags are piled in front of them and framed family photos hang on the wall behind.

photos.llama_desc: A man behind a long, wooden bar with a metal countertop, surrounded by stools and a row of taps and bottles on the wall behind him. He is wearing a blue t-shirt and a baseball cap, and has his hands on the counter.

photos.oracle_desc: A woman in an orange-red jacket stands on a path outdoors in very bright sunlight, holding a light-colored umbrella, with green grass and trees visible in the overexposed background.

photos.llama_desc: A woman in a white graduation gown. She is standing on a stone path, holding a diploma and a medal around her neck, with a smile on her face. She is wearing a white graduation cap and a long, white gown with a gold and red sash.
photos.oracle_desc: A young woman in a white graduation cap and gown sits on a low stone wall outdoors, smiling at the camera, wearing multiple colored honor cords and a medal, with green grass and trees behind her.

photos.oracle_desc: Five men pose together in a casual brewery setting — two standing in back, three seated in front — wearing various t-shirts and a flannel, all smiling at the camera.

photos.oracle_desc: A young man in a black tuxedo with a green bow tie and white boutonniere stands alone in a sunny park, smiling at the camera, with green trees and grass behind him.

photos.oracle_desc: Four cooked sausages on a white plate, browned from cooking, photographed close-up with a shallow depth of field against a dark background.

photos.oracle_desc: A young couple walks away from the camera down a sunlit park path, the young woman in a green dress and the young man in a black tuxedo, with trees lining the right side of the path.
